violations.why: irq_anchor (priority 6) can preempt irq_summit between its write and read of v_falcon, so the read may not see 0.
irq_anchor can preempt irq_kelp after it uses v_prism as an index and before the increment, so the increment reads a changed value.
irq_anchor can preempt the v_prism++ in irq_kelp between its read and write, so the anchor increment is lost.
irq_anchor can preempt irq_thorn between the read of v_prism at line 95 and the reset at line 101, so the earlier check is stale.
irq_kelp can preempt irq_thorn between the read of v_prism at line 95 and the reset at line 101, so the earlier check is stale.
